countingRule: Counts source-identified project and activity records, not unique physical projects. Exact repeated identifiers are deduplicated within each collection; the same physical work may still appear in multiple agencies' collections.

sources.name: PMGSY
sources.basis: data/nationwide-ingestion.json uniqueSourceWorks; spans the collected dashboard work records, not a complete national works ledger

sources.name: MPLADS
sources.basis: 59,785 Lok Sabha plus 16,020 Rajya Sabha work IDs; no exact work-ID overlap between the two house-filtered collections

sources.name: State project and tender collections
sources.basis: Latest projectCandidates files deduplicated by state code and sourceProjectId

sources.name: Union territory project and tender collections
sources.basis: Latest projectCandidates files deduplicated by territory code and sourceProjectId

sources.name: Odisha PPMS
sources.basis: data/ppms-state-acquisition.json; distinct codes across the acquired state bill rows

sources.name: Chandanbhati eGramSwaraj
sources.basis: Three acquired financial-year snapshots; activity IDs deduplicated across years

sources.name: Amarpur MGNREGA
sources.basis: Project details observed in the official portal; original work-register document is still pending

sources.name: Delhi SER-2
sources.basis: One identified tender with status-search observations; project documents have not been acquired

notAddedAgain: The 67,099 PMGSY working-window candidates are included in the PMGSY source-work count.
The 200 selected road records are already represented in PMGSY source records.
The 155 Odisha photo-location dossiers are within Odisha's PPMS project-code collection.
The 2,195 Odisha eSAKSHI MPLADS work IDs are within the MPLADS distinct-work total.
The 206 NHIDCL date-recovery records are within the state/territory project-ID collection.
Budget lines, expenditure candidates, map points and repeated bill rows are not counted as additional projects.
